title: 42 leading mathematicians warn that AI existential risk is real and urgent
summary: 42 Fellows of the Royal Society, including Fields Medal winners Martin Hairer and Peter Scholze, warn of existential AI risks in an open letter. Leading models have solved open research problems within months, and these capabilities could be just as effective in cyberweapons or bioweapons. By the time the public grasps the situation, it may be too late to act. The article 42 leading mathematicians warn that AI existential risk is real and urgent appeared first on The Decoder .
